name: Gov Authority
tagline: Ivory paper framed by red and blue bars, double rules, star emblem, tracked serif capitals and seal boxes (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Warm ivory with state red, deep blue and black ink

typography.style: Widely tracked serif capitals, small tracked sans labels, centered formal composition

best_for: Built for official reports and institutional occasions that call for gravity and ceremony. Symmetric layout and seals signal authority.
avoid_for: Avoid for startup, creative or casual presentations.
